Name: MisoMegu's Tatami Rugs

Description:
[size=3][center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/yaHTwzr.png[/img]﻿
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

There are some great tatami mats on here but none that let you customize! 
My tatami mats come in blocks and lets you create any tatami mat design you could think of!
Truly bring a touch of Japanese furnishing to your game now!

﻿﻿─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
﻿Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
『Replaces the Bamboo Mat and Burlap Rug』
Not required but I absolutely recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ to enjoy this mod to the fullest.
Of course as always, I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
